Terrible experience. I made an appointment to groom a long-haired Cocker Spaniel. They told me to come on Saturday, but when I arrived, I discovered that dogs are only bathed on Saturdays (why did you give me the appointment?) I booked a grooming appointment a month and a half after the wash and waited in the shop, during which at least five more dogs arrived. After a while, the groomer told me it was best to trim some of the fur because there were too many knots; I agreed, asking not to overdo it. They returned a Cocker Spaniel without any bangs. The next day at the vet, I noticed that the paws hadn't been touched: long dewclaws and pads covered in matted fur. I went to the groomer to ask for an explanation, and he told me that perhaps he forgot to treat not one paw, but all four (he didn't forget to charge me €50 despite being halfway through the job). I suggested he take on fewer dogs and work more efficiently. By the time I got in the car, the guy called me to yell that I didn't have the right to tell him how to work (he actually has the right to make fun of people) and that I brought him an indecent dog, forgetting that he had washed it himself a month earlier (let's ask ourselves some questions). He was keen to point out that he wasn't an employee (worse) and ordered me never to set foot in his shop again (who knows what made him think I would). My opinion: a coward who didn't have the courage to talk to me in person but hid behind a cell phone, greedy, arrogant, severely narrow-minded, and lazy. Advice: if you love your furry friends, stay away from this guy.
